checkpoint_rule: fixed last epoch 80 for all six arms; reuse full-model last.pt; no validation checkpoint selection
primary_decoder: unchanged E4 curve rules on logits, top5/NMS0.9
secondary_decoder: unchanged point decoder; no checkpoint reselection
primary_contrast: full minus retrained no_query curve MR-full-mAP, separately for MLP and Conv
secondary_contrasts: full minus position_only; full minus E4; point decoder; R1 and short mAP
hypothesis: query-conditioned heads outperform retrained query-free controls at a fixed training budget; position-only quantifies temporal prior
stop_rule: exactly four new fits; stop on hash/identity/finite-gradient/reload failure or wall-time cap; retain failures; no seed/width/epoch/threshold search
scope: previously observed official-train internal validation, single seed; controls support conditional query-use diagnosis, not independent generalization or action/order understanding
